# Microsoft Account Signup

> > Official Microsoft account registration portal for creating and managing new Microsoft accounts

This is the primary signup interface for Microsoft accounts, enabling users to create new accounts that provide access to Microsoft services including Outlook, Office, OneDrive, Xbox, and other Microsoft products. The portal handles account creation, registration confirmation, and initial onboarding workflows.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft account
- Account signup
- Registration confirmation
- Microsoft account creation
- User onboarding
- Account authentication
- Microsoft services access
- Sign-in confirmation
- New account registration
- Microsoft identity

## Account Registration

- [Sign up - Microsoft account](https://signup.live.com/finished.aspx?wa=wsignin1.0): Microsoft account registration completion and sign-in confirmation page
